landing.title: Customer portal

landing.headline: Everything your membership opens, in one place.

admin.service.empty.title: No services yet
admin.service.empty.body: Once a member is given a plan, their service appears here with its status, usage and expiry.
admin.service.attention: {0} service(s) need looking at. Each is one where a panel operation ended without a usable answer, or a queued step has stopped moving.
admin.service.member.hint: The most recent {0} accounts. Create the account first if it is not listed.
admin.service.plan.hint: Only plans that are visible and purchasable. The service copies its terms from the plan at this moment and keeps them, so later edits to the plan do not re-price it.
admin.service.notes.hint: For the back office. Not shown to the member.
admin.service.resetTrafficConfirm: The usage counter goes back to zero here and on the panel. This cannot be undone. Continue?
admin.service.decommissionConfirm: The client is removed from the panel and the member's subscription link stops working immediately. This cannot be undone. Continue?
admin.service.created: Service created. It will be set up on a panel within a minute or two.
admin.service.decommissioned: Service ended. The client is being removed from the panel.
admin.migration.title: Service moves
admin.migration.subtitle: Services being moved from one panel to another, and the ones already done.
admin.migration.move.subtitle: The client is created on the new server and checked before the old one is removed, so the customer is never left without a working configuration.
admin.migration.destination.hint: Only servers that are active, reachable, have a usable inbound and have room.
admin.migration.reason.hint: For the back office and the audit log. Not shown to the member.
admin.migration.explains: What is left of the traffic allowance is read from the current server and carried over. The expiry date is kept as it is — a move is not a renewal.
admin.migration.noDestination: There is no server to move this service to. Every other server is either full, unreachable, or has no usable inbound.
admin.migration.planned: The move has started. It runs in the background and takes a minute or two.
admin.migration.rolledBack: The move was called off. The service is untouched on its original server.
admin.migration.rollbackConfirm: Anything already created on the new server is removed. The service stays where it is. Continue?
admin.migration.dualActiveWarning: {0} service(s) are live on two servers at once. That is the normal state part-way through a move, but both servers count traffic against their own copy of the allowance — so anything sitting here for more than a few minutes needs looking at.
admin.migration.lockedHint: A move is in progress, so this service cannot be changed until it finishes.
admin.migration.empty.title: No moves yet
admin.migration.empty.body: When a service is moved from one server to another, its progress appears here.
admin.error.serviceMigrating: A move is in progress for this service. Wait for it to finish, or call it off first.
admin.error.migrationInFlight: This service is already being moved.
admin.error.migrationNotMigratable: Only an active or suspended service can be moved.
admin.error.migrationSameServer: That is the server the service is already on.
admin.error.migrationDestinationUnusable: That server cannot take a service — it is not active, not reachable, or has no usable inbound.
admin.error.migrationSourceUnreadable: The current server could not be read, so how much allowance is left is unknown. The move is refused rather than guessing.
admin.error.migrationNotRollbackable: This move has gone too far to call off — the new server has already been checked and may be serving the customer.
admin.plan.section.terms.note: Copied onto a service when it is created, and kept. Editing them later re-prices new services only — nobody who already bought this plan is affected.
admin.plan.key.hint: Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens. Fixed once saved.
admin.plan.key.fixed: Fixed: audit rows already refer to it.
admin.plan.country.hint: Two letters, e.g. DE. Leave empty to let the selector place it anywhere.
admin.plan.displayOrder.hint: Lower numbers come first in the catalogue.
admin.plan.duration.hint: How long a service on this plan lasts.
admin.plan.currency.hint: Three-letter code. Must match the currency members hold credit in.
admin.plan.visible.hint: Off withdraws the plan from the catalogue. Existing services keep running.
admin.plan.title: Service plans
admin.plan.subtitle: What a VPN service costs, how much it carries, and who may buy it.
admin.plan.empty.title: No plans yet
admin.plan.empty.body: Add a plan to describe what a service costs and what it includes.
admin.plan.traffic.hint: Zero means unlimited — the same convention the panel uses. 53687091200 is 50 GiB.
admin.plan.devices.hint: Zero means the panel imposes no limit.
admin.plan.price.hint: Whole numbers of the smallest unit. Rials have no minor unit, so 2500000 is 2,500,000 IRR.
admin.plan.purchasable.hint: Ordering also needs the Purchases feature, which is off — so this alone opens no checkout.
admin.plan.featured.hint: At most one per product. Setting it here clears the others.
admin.plan.audience.hint: No rules means anyone who can see the product. A deny always beats an allow.
admin.error.planKeyTaken: Another plan already uses that key.
admin.error.planKeyInvalid: A key may contain only lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.
admin.error.planCurrencyInvalid: A currency must be a three-letter code, e.g. IRR.
admin.error.planCountryInvalid: The country must be a two-letter code, e.g. DE.
admin.error.planDurationInvalid: A duration must be between 1 and 3650 days.
admin.error.planNegativeAmount: Traffic, price and device count cannot be negative.
admin.error.planRuleIncomplete: That rule needs a value for what it matches on.
admin.error.servicePlanNotFound: That plan no longer exists, so a service cannot be created on it.
admin.error.serviceNoServer: No server is available to place this service on.
admin.error.serviceNoCapacity: Every suitable server is full. Add capacity before creating more services.
admin.error.serviceNoInbound: No server has a usable inbound configured.
admin.error.serviceBusy: That service is mid-operation. Try again once it settles.
